dialogues.text: Ah, by Lesser Lord Kusanali, the weight on my shoulders has truly been lifted!

dialogues.speaker: Nazafarin
dialogues.text: Most good hearts do the two of you possess!

choices.text: You know, your manner of speech is kinda...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, "dear Lesser Lord Kusanali"! You mean how I tend to say things like that? Well, you see, I have a friend from Fontaine who enjoys talking like that.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: After spending too much time talking to him, I, too, began to speak in that fashion.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I would even say that I'm comparatively restrained... I just can't help myself at times. Blessed Kusanali, I'll do what I can, though.

choices.text: So, how do I use this pot of yours?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, yes, sorry. I would've forgotten if you hadn't reminded me, I'll wager.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: It's actually quite simple. You simply need to add the correct seasonings at the right time.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I'm sure you'll figure it out in just a couple of tries.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: See you! Thank you once again, Nazafarin's saviors!
